name: Forge a weapon! [ALPHA]
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Forge a Weapon! 🔥

Are you ready to Forge your very own Weapons? Buy Metals from the shop when they Restock and wait for them to Smelt, Forge them and collect the profits!
Flex Weapons and cool Metals on friends, and have fun!

💰 Buy Metals at the Market and put them in your Furnace.
⚒️ Forge Metals on your Anvil. 
🍀 You get RARE VFX on your Epic Swords when you hit the Jackpot! 🔮
💎 Flex your Weapons, or Sell them at the Market. 🤑
🔄 The Market will Restock new Metals!
🔮 Experience rare Events that give Special VFX to your Weapons.

Remember, your Forge literally Smelts while you are offline ⭐

scripts.title: Gui Toggle Antilag
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function safeCall(fn, ...)
    local ok, res = pcall(fn, ...)
    return ok, res
end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "SynapseAutoCollectGui"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 220)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -110)
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
Frame.Visible = false
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui

local UIPadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
UIPadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
UIPadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
UIPadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 12)
UIPadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12)
UIPadding.Parent = Frame

local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 14)
UIListLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIListLayout.Parent = Frame

local function createOption(name)
    local optionFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    optionFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    optionFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    optionFrame.Parent = Frame

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Text = name
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    label.TextSize = 20
    label.Parent = optionFrame

    local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 1, 0)
    toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 0)
    toggle.Text = "False"
    toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    toggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    toggle.TextSize = 18
    toggle.Parent = optionFrame

    return toggle
end

local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 34)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)
ToggleButton.Text = "Toggle GUI"
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

local HideTycoonsCheckbox = createOption("Hide Other Tycoons")
local RemovePlayersCheckbox = createOption("Remove Players")
local AutoCollectCheckbox = createOption("AutoCollect (fireproximityprompt)")

local hideTycoonsEnabled = false
local hideTycoonsWasEnabled = false
local removePlayersEnabled = false
local autoCollectEnabled = false

local function getAllFurnaces()
    local furnaces = {}
    local Map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not Map then return furnaces end
    local Tycoons = Map:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
    if not Tycoons then return furnaces end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local tycoon = Tycoons:FindFirstChild("Tycoon" .. i)
        if tycoon then
            local furnaceFolder = tycoon:FindFirstChild("Furnaces")
            if furnaceFolder then
                for j = 0, 11 do
                    local fname = (j == 0) and "Furnace" or ("Furnace" .. j)
                    local f = furnaceFolder:FindFirstChild(fname)
                    if f then
                        table.insert(furnaces, f)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return furnaces
end

local function clearTycoonVisuals()
    local Map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
    if not Map then return end
    local Tycoons = Map:FindFirstChild("Tycoons")
    if not Tycoons then return end
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local tycoon = Tycoons:FindFirstChild("Tycoon" .. i)
        if tycoon and tycoon:GetAttribute("Owner") ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
            for _, obj in pairs(tycoon:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Model") and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                else
                    pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function rejoin()
    local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    pcall(function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer) end)
end

local function setPlayersVisibility(visible)
    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            for _, part in pairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    pcall(function() part.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1 end)
                elseif part:IsA("Decal") then
                    pcall(function() part.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1 end)
                elseif part:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or part:IsA("Trail") then
                    pcall(function() part.Enabled = visible end)
                elseif part:IsA("BillboardGui") or part:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
                    pcall(function() part.Enabled = visible end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if removePlayersEnabled and player ~= LocalPlayer then
            task.wait(0.5)
            setPlayersVisibility(false)
        end
    end)
end)

for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        if removePlayersEnabled and p ~= LocalPlayer then
            task.wait(0.5)
            setPlayersVisibility(false)
        end
    end)
end

local debounce = {}
local DEBOUNCE_TIME = 0.8
local SCAN_INTERVAL = 0.32

local function tryFireProximityPrompt(prox)
    if type(fireproximityprompt) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end
    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        fireproximityprompt(prox)
    end)
    return ok
end

local function scanAndAutoCollect()
    local furnaces = getAllFurnaces()
    for _, furnace in ipairs(furnaces) do
        local skript = furnace:FindFirstChild("Skript")
        if skript then
            local proxFolder = skript:FindFirstChild("Proximity")
            if proxFolder then
                local prox = proxFolder:FindFirstChild("TakeOutMetal")
                if prox and prox:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and prox.Enabled then
                    local id = tostring(prox)
                    if (not debounce[id]) or (tick() - debounce[id] > DEBOUNCE_TIME) then
                        debounce[id] = tick()
                        safeCall(tryFireProximityPrompt, prox)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local autoCollectThread
local function startAutoCollectLoop()
    if autoCollectThread then return end
    autoCollectThread = task.spawn(function()
        while autoCollectEnabled do
            scanAndAutoCollect()
            task.wait(SCAN_INTERVAL)
        end
        autoCollectThread = nil
    end)
end

local function stopAutoCollectLoop()
    autoCollectEnabled = false
end

HideTycoonsCheckbox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    hideTycoonsEnabled = not hideTycoonsEnabled
    HideTycoonsCheckbox.Text = tostring(hideTycoonsEnabled)
    if hideTycoonsEnabled then
        clearTycoonVisuals()
        hideTycoonsWasEnabled = true
    else
        if hideTycoonsWasEnabled then
            rejoin()
        end
    end
end)

RemovePlayersCheckbox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    removePlayersEnabled = not removePlayersEnabled
    RemovePlayersCheckbox.Text = tostring(removePlayersEnabled)
    if removePlayersEnabled then
        setPlayersVisibility(false)
    else
        setPlayersVisibility(true)
    end
end)

AutoCollectCheckbox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    autoCollectEnabled = not autoCollectEnabled
    AutoCollectCheckbox.Text = tostring(autoCollectEnabled)
    if autoCollectEnabled then
        startAutoCollectLoop()
    else
        stopAutoCollectLoop()
    end
end)

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
end)
